---
title: Manage Automation
description: >-
  Review your active automation routines, monitor running workflow statuses at a
  glance, and edit individual trigger rules or delete outdated backend
  sequences.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Automation > Automation List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="302" height="200" style="width: 302px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view existing automation details, delete or duplicate the specific campaign.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="682" height="280" style="width: 682px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Manage and modify existing automation workflows, including the ability to replicate or remove campaigns.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="631" height="360" style="width: 631px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
